title: The new VELOCITY is here
sub: CHROMASHIFT now has a second game: racing. Up to six cars, real driving, your own garage.

sections.title: New
items: VELOCITY racing: pick the car icon on Play. Race bots offline, or friends with your game code.
10 new race tracks: Coastal Sprint, Neon Circuit, Prism Canyon, Skyline Rush, Dye Docks, Bloom Raceway, Core Raceway, Arcade Velocity, Frozen Apex and Sunset Drift.
Real driving: grip, drifts, mini-turbos, boost, slipstream, and suspension that leans in the corners and bounces over the hills.
The Garage: a 3D showroom for your car. 6 bodies, 32 colours, 56 paint finishes, 24 wheels, bumpers, spoilers, lights, horns, engine sounds, trails, smoke and more. Keep 3 saved builds.
Crashes leave dents, scratches and broken lights, and a bad one slows you down. Your car is always fixed after the race.
Arcade races with pickups: Turbo, Shield, Paint Slick, Shockwave, Repair, Slipstream and Decoy.
Racing bots on 4 levels, racing stats and personal records on your profile, and new racing quests.
Build your own tracks in the new track editor, then test drive them.

sections.title: Changed
items: Play has two games at the top: CHROMASHIFT (the gun) and VELOCITY (the car).
Settings → Controls has a gun and a car too, so driving keys and buttons are set separately.
The Locker has a Garage button for your cars.
One extra daily and weekly quest, for racing. Your other quests are the same.

sections.title: Removed
items: Nothing. Every CHROMASHIFT map, weapon, item, friend and coin is still here.
